label: DigitalOcean infrastructure connector
summary: Prepare provider-specific inventory and approved lifecycle requests for selected DigitalOcean resources.
core_boundary: The connector maps a chosen external account; Core Platform remains authoritative for nodes and their local service admission. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Fence account and region/resource scope before reading or mutating a referenced workload.
Qualify image, network and volume mappings without claiming a development image is a production release.
Preserve uncertain create/delete outcomes after timeout and inspect before retrying a billed operation.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
